Jensen Huang Explains His Everyday Uniform
Huang explained his approach to clothing during a CBS News interview with correspondent Jo Ling Kent that aired Sunday.
When Kent asked how many leather jackets he owns, Huang said he has between 30 and 40, many of which his wife, Laurie, bought for him.
The Nvidia CEO said he sticks to a consistent wardrobe because it removes the need to choose clothes every day. "Black is the absence of choice," Huang said.
He explained that wearing the same clothes ensures that everything fits and feels familiar, leaving him with one fewer decision to make.

"Yeah, go focus on something else. That’s one decision made," Huang stated, adding that while most people may have to make several decisions about what to wear, he has already removed that task from his day.
"The moment I wake up, I could be thinking about important things," he said.
